APPROVE
The refactor keeps every check in the same order and builds each verdict with the same arguments, including the HEAD pin, the `NotMeasured` default delta and the empty rescans and side moves when no units are measured, so behaviour looks unchanged; `JudgeAsync` now has about 13–14 flat decision points, and I see nothing that should break the build (types, nullability flow and member scopes all check out), though I reviewed the diff by reading it and did not compile it.
